voice.name: Noordheim — Commander Ravn
voice.description: An original male Scandinavian military commander in his late forties, speaking clear English with a subtle Norwegian accent. Deep resonant baritone, a little weathered gravel, firm clipped consonants, concise tactical radio delivery. Calm authority under pressure, alert and decisive rather than theatrical or angry. Measured medium pace with energetic short sentences. Clean close microphone, no music, no effects, no shouting.
voice.preview: Northern Command, radio check. The fjord is quiet, but it will not stay that way. Establish your perimeter and bring the vehicles online. Keep your crews together. When the signal comes, we move north.

deploy: [confident] Northern Command online. Establish your base. Secure the crossings.
hold: Hold this position. Watch the approaches.
armorReady: Armor is ready. Give us a target.
baseUnderAttack: [urgent] Command station under attack! Reinforce the perimeter.
unitLost: [grim] Unit lost. Regroup and hold the line.
lowPower: [concerned] Power grid overloaded. Bring another plant online.
insufficient: We need more supplies for that order.
queueFull: Production queue is full. Stand by.
wave: [urgent] Hostile reinforcements inbound. Defend the crossings.
victory: [proud] The fjord is ours. Well fought, Commander.
defeat: [grave] Command is lost. Fall back. We will return.
radioCheck: Commander Ravn. Reading you loud and clear.

exploration.title: Skerry Watch
exploration.prompt: Original instrumental soundtrack for a modern Scandinavian real-time strategy game. 96 BPM, D minor, restrained tactical tension on an icy fjord. Deep pulsing analog bass, delicate metallic arpeggios, muted low strings, sparse military toms, distant bowed Nordic fiddle textures and airy cold synthesizer pads. A memorable understated two-bar motif. Clear space in the midrange for a spoken commander. Steady evolving groove, not a cinematic trailer. No singing, chanting, spoken words or choir. Start directly in the groove. Maintain the same tempo, key and energy with subtle variation for the entire piece, no dramatic ending, no fade-out, suitable for continuous looping under base building. 90 seconds.

combat.title: Northern Advance
combat.prompt: Original instrumental combat soundtrack for a modern Scandinavian real-time strategy game. 96 BPM, D minor. Driving industrial military drums, a weighty syncopated distorted bass riff, tight palm-muted electric guitar ostinatos, cold analog synth arpeggios and short low string accents. Subtle bowed Nordic fiddle texture connects it to an icy northern coast. Confident, urgent and rhythmic, with enough headroom and midrange space for radio orders. Instrumental only: no singing, spoken words, chants or choir. Begin immediately with the full steady groove. Maintain consistent rhythm and key with small evolving variations, no breakdowns, no trailer crescendos, no dramatic final hit or fade-out; suitable for looping during long tactical battles. 90 seconds.

fjordborn.name: Captain Sigrid Havn
fjordborn.description: An original female Scandinavian raider captain in her thirties. Bright, quick and confident alto with salty coastal edge, fast energetic pace, a hint of a grin, eager for the fight. Speaking clear English with a subtle Norwegian accent. Concise tactical radio delivery. Clean close microphone, no music, no effects.
fjordborn.preview: Havn here. The tide is turning and so are we. Load the boats, keep it quick, and hit them before they wake. Go, go, go.

deploy: [energetic] Havn on the line. Build fast, strike faster.
baseUnderAttack: [urgent] They are at the landing! Everyone back!
unitLost: [angry] We lost a crew. Keep moving.
victory: [triumphant] The coast is ours! Good raiding.
defeat: [bitter] Back to the boats. We come again.
radioCheck: Captain Havn, coastal raiders. Loud and clear.

ironclad.name: Colonel Brand Hammar
ironclad.description: An original male Scandinavian fortress colonel in his sixties. Very deep, slow, heavy bass voice with iron gravel, deliberate and unshakable, few words, dry authority, like a mountain speaking. Speaking clear English with a subtle Norwegian accent. Concise tactical radio delivery. Clean close microphone, no music, no effects.
ironclad.preview: Hammar. The pass is ours as long as the walls stand. Pour the concrete. Load the guns. Let them come to us.

deploy: [calm] Hammar. Pour the foundations. We hold here.
baseUnderAttack: [stern] They test our walls. Man the batteries.
victory: [satisfied] The pass holds. As it always will.
defeat: [grave] The walls have fallen. We rebuild.
radioCheck: Colonel Hammar, mountain garrison. Reading you.

hearthkin.name: Major Liv Åker
hearthkin.description: An original female Scandinavian logistics major in her forties. Warm, grounded, practical mezzo voice with a friendly farmstead lilt, organised and reassuring, brisk medium pace, firm when needed. Speaking clear English with a subtle Norwegian accent. Concise tactical radio delivery. Clean close microphone, no music, no effects.
hearthkin.preview: Åker speaking. Harvesters are rolling and the depots are full. Keep the columns moving and we will outlast anyone out here.

deploy: [warm] Åker here. Set up the depots, get the harvesters rolling.
attackMove: [determined] Push forward, secure the supply line.
baseUnderAttack: [urgent] The depot is hit! Protect the stores!
unitLost: [concerned] We lost a crew. Send another.
insufficient: [practical] The stores are thin. We need more ore.
victory: [proud] The valley feeds us now. Fine work.
defeat: [sad] Load what we can. Fall back to the farms.
radioCheck: Major Åker, valley logistics. Clear signal.

ashwalkers.name: Captain Tor Aske
ashwalkers.description: An original male Scandinavian forest reconnaissance captain in his thirties. Low, hushed, focused baritone, close and intimate like a whisper over a radio, calm and watchful, precise, a little mysterious. Speaking clear English with a subtle Norwegian accent. Concise tactical radio delivery. Clean close microphone, no music, no effects.
ashwalkers.preview: Aske. Eyes on the treeline. They have not seen us yet. Stay low, stay quiet, and wait for my mark. Then we move.

deploy: [quiet] Aske. Scouts out. Find them first.
attackMove: [quiet] Advance slow. Engage what you see.
enemySpotted: [alert] Contact. I see them before they see us.
baseUnderAttack: [urgent] They found the camp. Pull back and fight.
victory: [calm] The woods are ours. Quiet again.
defeat: [quiet] Scatter into the ash. We regroup later.
radioCheck: Captain Aske, forest recon. I hear you.
